note.question: How do revisiting quantity and price competition in a differentiated industry compare?
note.overview: Previous studies have shown that quantity commitment by all firms in an industry mitigates price competition. To study the commitment decision, we analyze a multistage game within a duopoly of differentiated firms à la Hotelling. In the first stage of the game, firms choose whether or not to commit to a quantity.
